title.en: The mole and amount of substance

summary.en: The mole is the SI unit for counting particles, defined so that one mole of any substance contains the same number of entities — which lets a mass measured on a balance be converted into a count of atoms or molecules.
summary.et: Mool on SI-ühik osakeste loendamiseks, defineeritud nii, et üks mool mistahes ainet sisaldab sama arvu osakesi — see lubab kaalul mõõdetud massi teisendada aatomite või molekulide arvuks.
